=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4046-4074 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: reviewer_failure_evidence strips the "| " prefix (lines 4049-4051) before the stage-stderr-only plain-ERROR match (line 4074), but scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:4731-4736 writes the model-CLI stderr tail, indented "  | ", to the step's own stderr, which is teed into reviewers_stage_stderr.txt. Model-CLI noise such as "  | ERROR ... request <id> rejected" is therefore kept as the step's plain ERROR evidence line, which the docstring at 4035-4039 says must never happen.
  WHY: The kept line drives failure_headline / AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR and wins error_signature bucket 3 (\bERROR\b, line 577); normalize_error_line (3838-3852) leaves letter-bearing ids in place, so the fp drifts between runs, `GATE_FINGERPRINT_CAP_FP == autofix_failure_fp` (post_editor_summary.sh:154) never matches, and the existing identical-failure cap stops tripping (a regression from base per anthropic). The test test_reviewer_failure_evidence_keeps_the_bash_diagnostic_line (tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:5787-5791) passes only because its noise goes through log_texts, not stage_stderr_texts. openai_gpt-6-luna also notes that the stripped lines can match the bash-diagnostic parser. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4046-4073 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The bash-diagnostic branch (line 4065, `_normalise_bash_diagnostic(line)`) is not gated on `from_stage_stderr`, so it also accepts diagnostic-shaped lines from slot logs (model-CLI stderr and review prose). Slot logs are read first (line 4046), so such a line wins over the real stage-stderr crash line, contradicting the comment at 4000-4002 and the docstring at 4035-4039.
  WHY: Varying model output (e.g. `bash: line 3: foo: command not found` or `render_prompt.sh: line 306: 1abc: invalid variable name`) decides the fingerprint through the new bucket at 583-588. The fp then changes between runs of the same deterministic crash, so neither the in-run repeat block nor the 2-strike cap fires. All three rated it MAJOR; minimax gave confidence 3, the others 4. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 listed the indented variant only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4065-4073 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The kept bash-diagnostic line is appended to helper_lines with only `single_line(bash_diagnostic, 300)`. It is never passed through `redact_secrets()`, which the adjacent plain-ERROR line does get (4081-4082).
  WHY: A credential-shaped token in a shell diagnostic would be written unredacted to failure_evidence_tail.txt and posted in the heal issue body (workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:307-309), because sanitize_text() only strips control characters. Both reviewers rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 raised the same fix (line 4070) only as hardening suggestions; anthropic said it is not a regression and minimax noted the published payload is redacted downstream.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3995-4081 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The stage stderr is read after the slot logs (line 4046) and shares the single `REVIEWER_FAILURE_HELPER_LINES_MAX = 10` budget (line 3995; cap checks at 4069/4081) with them.
  WHY: Noisy slot logs can fill the budget and drop the real crash line. failure_headline (4933-4943) then falls back to a generic line, AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR stays empty, and the fingerprint stops naming the crash (spec item 3). All three rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to report it because no concrete trigger was shown.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:575-590 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The keyword list of the new last-priority `_SIGNATURE_PATTERNS` bucket (583-588) omits `error|fail`, which `_BASH_DIAGNOSTIC_MSG_RE` (4004-4009) includes, even though the comment at line 582 says it uses "the same words".
  WHY: A kept diagnostic whose message has only a "fail" word, or a substring form such as "errors", matches no bucket, so error_signature returns the constant "no-error-lines". Unrelated crashes then collide on one fp, and the 2-strike reviewers_failed cap (evaluate_gate.sh:956-958) wrongly applies ai:review-blocked. All three rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to report it because bucket 3 already matches "error"/"FAILED" case-insensitively.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:112-113 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The fingerprint output of the python command is parsed with printf/sed, and the python command's exit status is never checked.
  WHY: If fingerprint generation fails, the marker and fp variables stay empty and the reviewers_failed gate fails open, so a deterministic failure is retried. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected it because an empty fp keeping today's retry is the documented fail-open behaviour.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3467-3485 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `$!` still points at the background materiality job (3467-3468) when the `2> >(tee -a ...)` process substitution at 3480 is created, so `wait $!` at 3481 waits for the materiality job instead of the tee.
  WHY: The intended flush of reviewers_stage_stderr.txt is not guaranteed, so the next step (Post editor summary comment) can miss a tail crash line. The window is small. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When the review fails... and the newest earlier review-autofix-failure:v1 marker for the same head has the same fp=, ... post one comment that names the repeated fingerprint and the first stderr line of the failing step."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_autofix_step_failure_comment.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: According to gemini, review_autofix_step_failure_comment.sh posts "Repeated reviewer failure" only when `${AUTOFIX_REVIEWERS_FAILED_REPEATED:-false}` is "true", and review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh sets that variable only when `reviewers_failed_repeat_max` (default 2) is reached, so the first same-head, same-fp repeat gets no comment. Disputed by anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3: per post_editor_summary.sh:144-158, prior count 1 + 1 >= 2 fires on the first repeat, and review_autofix.yml:5761/5805 together with failure_comment.sh:66-71 post the comment.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:reviewer_failure_evidence, lines 4049-4051 (line = raw_line.strip(); if line.startswith("| "): line = line[2:].strip()) and line 4074 (plain_error = _PLAIN_ERROR_LINE_RE.match(line) if from_stage_stderr else None). Related code: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh lines 4731-4736 and lines 5778/5780 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plain ERROR branch is limited to stage stderr on the assumption that stage stderr holds no model-CLI stderr. In fact slots run with >&2 (5778/5780) and the "  | " model-CLI stderr tail (4731-4736) is teed into reviewers_stage_stderr.txt. With the "| " prefix stripped, "  | ERROR ... ses_AbCx.. rejected" is kept as the plain ERROR evidence line. The test passes only because slot_noise goes through log_texts.
  WHY: It feeds failure_headline / AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR and error_signature, where bucket 3 wins before bucket 5. normalize_error_line (3838-3852) keeps letter-bearing ids, so the fp differs on every run, the same-head repeat block never matches, and the existing identical-failure cap (2 for reviewers_failed, 3 otherwise) no longer trips, which is worse than base. Fix: track whether the line was indented and require from_stage_stderr and not indented, plus a test that sends "  | ERROR" through stage_stderr_texts.
- HARDENING scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py reviewer_failure_evidence, lines 4065-4073: the bash-diagnostic branch accepts "| "-indented model-CLI stderr from both slot logs and stage stderr, and the comment at 3999-4002 is wrong. Fix: prefer non-indented stage-stderr diagnostics or skip indented ones (about 4 lines).
- HARDENING scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py reviewer_failure_evidence, line 4070: the bash-diagnostic line is not redacted. Fix: bash_diagnostic = single_line(redact_secrets(bash_diagnostic), 300) (1 line).
- NOTES: rejected the gemini task gap (threshold 2 = first repeat) and the gemini NIT on the fingerprint exit code (fail-open is documented). Did not report the minimax redaction NIT (not a regression; _cmd_autofix_failure_fingerprint line 9478 behaves the same), the glm bucket keyword mismatch, or the shared 10-line budget. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
